name: Additions
overview: Scripture warns against adding hypocrisy to our dealings with others, urging believers to first address their own faults before correcting others, as illustrated in Luke 6:42. God's purpose in sending His Son was not to condemn but to bring salvation to the world, emphasizing the grace extended through Christ (John 3:17). Furthermore, the call to repentance, baptism in Jesus' name, and receiving the Holy Spirit highlights the essential steps for forgiveness and spiritual renewal (Acts 2:38). Together, these verses underscore the importance of genuine self-examination, faith in Christ's saving work, and obedient response to God's call.
